snippet.title: The ONE Who Wouldn't Leave *TRAILER* Horror Game
snippet.description:
I recently released my indie psychological horror game on Itch.io and I’d really appreciate it if you gave it a try. The game focuses on tension, atmosphere, and a disturbing story about moving into a new apartment where things slowly start to go wrong.

If you’re into horror experiences, feel free to check it out here:
👉 https://mario-dev.itch.io/the-one-who-wouldnt-leave

Any feedback is welcome and truly appreciated. Thank you for your time! 🙏

    Credits:
     Music: Death Clock by Soundridemusic
     Link to Video:    • Ticking Horror Suspense No Copyright Trail...  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dqBYL-d9GQc
